collection.title: College Placement Interview Coach
collection.description: Targeted technical & behavioral interview questions with answer framing blueprints and rubric breakdown.
collection.scopeLabel: 4 Tech & Behavioral Interview Scenarios for Engineering Students

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: How would you design a scalable distributed rate limiter supporting millions of requests per second with microsecond latencies?

metadata.framework: Token Bucket / Sliding Window Counter with Redis and Lua scripts
metadata.evalCriteria: Evaluates concurrency handling, clock drift, redis clustering, and fail-open policies.

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: Explain how you implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with $O(1)$ get and put time complexity.

metadata.idealAnswer: Combine a Hash Map (for O(1) key lookups) with a Doubly Linked List (for O(1) node eviction and head-promotions).

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: Compare Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) with Pessimistic Locking. Under what workload profile is OCC clearly superior?

metadata.idealAnswer: OCC assumes conflicts are rare, checking version stamps before commits. It is superior in read-heavy workloads with low write contention.

items.subject: Career & Behavioral
items.body: Tell me about a time when you strongly disagreed with a senior engineer or teammate on a technical decision. How did you handle it and what was the outcome?

metadata.framework: STAR: Situation, Task, Action (data-driven prototyping, respectful dissent), Result.
